title: Neurogene Reports Positive Long-term Clinical Data from Phase 1/2 Trial of NGN-401 Gene Therapy for Rett Syndrome
summary: NEW YORK, June 29, 2026--Neurogene Inc. (Nasdaq: NGNE), a clinical-stage company founded to bring life-changing genetic medicines to patients and families affected by rare neurological diseases, today announced updated, positive data from its Phase 1/2 clinical trial evaluating NGN-401 gene therapy for the treatment of females with Rett syndrome.
